steps.name: Assess
steps.desc: We map the current workflow, systems, constraints and people involved, and agree the problem before choosing a solution.

steps.name: Prioritize
steps.desc: We compare opportunities by value, feasibility and dependencies, then agree a baseline and what success means.

steps.name: Build
steps.desc: We test the riskiest assumptions first, then design and engineer in reviewable increments around the real workflow.

steps.name: Adopt
steps.desc: We support rollout and handover, document how the system runs, and agree how to measure and improve it.

cta.title: Want to see how this applies to your work?
cta.text: Questions about our process? We’re happy to talk it through.
